definitions.explanation: A coin-operated device installed at the roadside that allows temporary paid parking for a set duration, typically 60 minutes in Japan.

examples.japanese: パーキングメーター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put coins into the parking meter.

examples.japanese: パーキングメーター⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}→駐車違反：21077_chuushaihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the parking meter time runs out, it becomes a parking violation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧パーキングメーター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されていて→する：00392_suru⟧、{六十分|ろくじゅっぷん}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧なら⟦{路上|ろじょう}{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→路上駐車：24063_rojouchuusha⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Parking meters are installed on this street, and you can park on the road for up to 60 minutes.

notes:
A loanword from English "parking meter." In Japan, parking meters are found mainly on major streets in urban areas and allow parking for a set time (usually 60 minutes) during operating hours (typically 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM). Outside operating hours, the meters are generally free to use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パーキングメーター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put (coins) in the parking meter
- パーキングメーター⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: the parking meter time expires
- パーキングメーター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install parking meters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: parking lot, parking garage — a dedicated facility
- ⟦コインパーキング→コインパーキング：24421_koinpaakingu⟧: coin parking (lot) — a small automated pay-by-time parking lot
- パーキング⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧: parking ticket (receipt from meter); also a type of metered parking using dashboard tickets
